ayahs.tr: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.ar: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۝٢ۙۛ
ayahs.tr: By the clear Book,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ فِيْ لَيْلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِيْنَ ۝٣
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

ayahs.ar: فِيْهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ حَكِيْمٍ ۝٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -

ayahs.ar: اَمْرًا مِّنْ عِنْدِنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِيْنَ ۝٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

ayahs.ar: رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۝٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۘ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ ۝٧
ayahs.tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

ayahs.ar: لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيٖ وَيُمِيْتُؕ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ اٰبَا࢜ىِٕكُمُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝٨
ayahs.tr: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

ayahs.ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ يَّلْعَبُوْنَ ۝٩
ayahs.tr: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

ayahs.ar: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَا࢜ءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝١٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.

ayahs.ar: يَّغْشَي النَّاسَؕ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ ۝١١
ayahs.tr: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۝١٢
ayahs.tr: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

ayahs.ar: اَنّٰي لَهُمُ الذِّكْرٰي وَقَدْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝١٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوْا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُوْنٌ ۝١٤ۘ
ayahs.tr: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الْعَذَابِ قَلِيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ عَا࢜ىِٕدُوْنَ ۝١٥ۘ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرٰيۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَا࢜ءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ كَرِيْمٌ ۝١٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

ayahs.ar: اَنْ اَدُّوْٓا اِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِيْنٌ ۝١٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنْ لَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيْٓ اٰتِيْكُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝١٩ۚ
ayahs.tr: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ اَنْ تَرْجُمُوْنِ ۝٢٠ؗ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ لَّمْ تُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْا لِيْ فَاعْتَزِلُوْنِ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗٓ اَنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُوْنَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

ayahs.ar: فَاَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْ لَيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ ۝٢٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

ayahs.ar: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًاؕ اِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

ayahs.ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوْا مِنْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۝٢٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

ayahs.ar: وَّزُرُوْعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيْمٍ ۝٢٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And crops and noble sites

ayahs.ar: وَّنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْا فِيْهَا فٰكِهِيْنَ ۝٢٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And comfort wherein they were amused.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَاَوْرَثْنٰهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِيْنَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَا࢜ءُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْا مُنْظَرِيْنَ ۝٢٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِيْنِ ۝٣٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

ayahs.ar: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ ۝٣١
ayahs.tr: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنٰهُمْ عَلٰي عِلْمٍ عَلَي الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٣٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الْاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيْهِ بَلٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ٌا مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٣٣
ayahs.tr: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

ayahs.ar: اِنْ هِيَ اِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْاُوْلٰي وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِيْنَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

ayahs.ar: فَاْتُوْا بِاٰبَا࢜ىِٕنَا͏ٓ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.tr: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: اَهُمْ خَيْرٌ اَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۙ وَّالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْؗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِيْنَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.tr: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيْنَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.tr: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

ayahs.ar: مَا خَلَقْنٰهُمَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.tr: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيْقَاتُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٤٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ مَوْلًي عَنْ مَّوْلًي شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ۝٤١ۙ
ayahs.tr: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۝٤٢ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِ ۝٤٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

ayahs.ar: طَعَامُ الْاَثِيْمِ ۝٤٤ۚۖۛ
ayahs.tr: Is food for the sinful.

ayahs.ar: كَالْمُهْلِۚۛ يَغْلِيْ فِي الْبُطُوْنِ ۝٤٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

ayahs.ar: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيْمِ ۝٤٦
ayahs.tr: Like the boiling of scalding water.

ayahs.ar: خُذُوْهُ فَاعْتِلُوْهُ اِلٰي سَوَا࢜ءِ الْجَحِيْمِ ۝٤٧ࣗۖ
ayahs.tr: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْا فَوْقَ رَاْسِهٖ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيْمِ ۝٤٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

ayahs.ar: ذُقْۚۙ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْكَرِيْمُ ۝٤٩
ayahs.tr: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَمْتَرُوْنَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.tr: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ مَقَامٍ اَمِيْنٍ ۝٥١ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
Within gardens and springs,

ayahs.ar: يَّلْبَسُوْنَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَ ۝٥٣ۚۙ
ayahs.tr: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍ ۝٥٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

ayahs.ar: يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيْنَ ۝٥٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا الْمَوْتَ اِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْاُوْلٰيۚ وَوَقٰىهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ ۝٥٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

ayahs.ar: فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ ۝٥٧
ayahs.tr: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.tr: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.

ayahs.ar: فَارْتَقِبْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّرْتَقِبُوْنَ ۝٥٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
